title: Satin tie-in and end lock on a 3.5 mm column
description: A 5 × 3.5 mm Manual Punch column in satin at density 3, without under sewing, must start and end as PE-DESIGN 11.50 does: a tie-in of three 0.3 mm steps out along the first rung and two back (the first stitch is longer than 3 mm), and an end lock of one 0.3 mm step back along the last rung (it is shorter than 4.25 mm).

featureMatrix.feature: Manual Punch: shapes made of several sewing-direction lines

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-lock-column-3p5.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): the jump lands on the start point, then 21 stitches: tie-in (out to 0.3 mm, the landing move itself, then 0.6 and 0.9 mm, back 0.4 and 0.5 mm: 4 stitches), 8 rungs 5/7 mm apart as a sawtooth (15 crossings), end lock (2). With satin-zigzag-column (2 mm rungs: one tie-in step) and the round-1 satin files (one lock step after ≤ 2 mm, two after 5 and 30 mm) it places the rule's cuts between 2.3 and 3.5 mm (tie-in) and 3.5 and 5 mm (lock).

references.make: Shapes > Manual Punch > Straight Block (sew type Satin Stitch), punch a 5 mm long, 3.5 mm wide straight column between (10, 10)–(10, 13.5) and (15, 10)–(15, 13.5) mm, density 3.0 lines/mm, Under Sewing off, other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-lock-column-3p5.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): after the move to 0.3 mm, the tie-in sews 4 stitches (0.6 and 0.9 mm out, 0.4–0.5 mm back); the column's 15 crossings and 2-stitch lock are left out.
PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-lock-column-3p5.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): the tie-in and lock steps are 0.3 mm.
